skills.name: aclnn-doc-gen
skills.description: Generate Huawei CANN ACLNN operator API reference documentation. Use when asked to: generate ACLNN operator docs; analyze chip/product support differences; extract operator info (parameters, constraints, formulas); compare related interfaces (V1 vs V2, WeightNz variants); or understand an operator's function/params/constraints from its source directory. Follows the external orchestration flow (preprocess -> extract+compare in parallel -> formula+generate_skeleton in parallel -> review).

skills.name: api-doc-qc-aclnn
skills.description: Quality-check aclnn operator API reference docs against preset rules: spec compliance, code-doc consistency, completeness, readability, correctness. Triggers on checking/reviewing/auditing aclnn*.md docs.

skills.name: ascendc-api-retrieval
skills.description: Search the Ascend C operator development API documentation.

skills.name: ascendc-doc-gen
skills.description: Generate Huawei CANN AscendC API reference docs from C++ headers: chip/product support analysis, function prototype/parameter/constraint extraction. Runs four LLM stages (chipdiff -> extract -> generate -> review) inside an external orchestration flow.

skills.name: ascendc-markdown-quality-checker
skills.description: AscendC-specific Markdown quality check: structural integrity, language fluency, spec compliance, correctness. Triggers: AscendC + Markdown + quality check.

skills.name: extract-logs
skills.description: Parse raw gtest / ctest / run_cpu.py / run_st.py logs into a normalized results object (passed/failed/skipped counts + per-case status). Use after a run, or when asked to extract or normalize test logs into structured results.

skills.name: full-analysis-pipeline
skills.description: Orchestrate the full regression flow end to end: run-testcase -> extract-logs -> generate-report -> review-inconsistencies, then hand off to skill-maintainer when corrections or reusable patterns surface. Use when asked to run the full analysis pipeline or a complete regression analysis.

skills.name: general-markdown-quality-checker
skills.description: General Markdown quality check: structure, language fluency, correctness, and npu/@ref tag validity. For punctuation/spacing/path use markdown-punctuation-quality-checker; compliance use markdown-compliance-quality-checker; filenames use markdown-filename-quality-checker; AscendC docs use ascendc-markdown-quality-checker; aclnn docs use api-doc-qc-aclnn.

skills.name: generate-report
skills.description: Turn normalized run results into a Markdown summary and a standalone HTML report. Use when asked to generate a report or dashboard from a regression run, or after the pipeline has produced results.

skills.name: markdown-compliance-quality-checker
skills.description: Markdown compliance check: terminology, tables, privacy, typos, non-standard terms, and discontinued-product terms (non-political). For general structure/language/tags use general-markdown-quality-checker.

skills.name: markdown-filename-quality-checker
skills.description: Check Markdown filenames for spec/correctness on a single file or a directory of files.

skills.name: markdown-punctuation-quality-checker
skills.description: Check Markdown punctuation and spacing: Chinese-English mixed spacing, missing/mismatched punctuation, path format.

skills.name: pto-isa
skills.description: Run and triage pto-isa regression: CPU simulator ST and NPU simulator ST (A5/A3/A6, incl. the A6 dav_9201 / v200 workflow), plus env/soc handling and known failure patterns. Use when working in the pto-isa repo, running pto-isa tests, or asked for a pto-isa regression run or failure triage.

skills.name: pto-vmi
skills.description: Run and triage pto-vmi regression: DSL ST and CCE ST on the A5 simulator (ptoas-vmi msprof / bisheng + camodel), plus the CCE-vs-VMI CA metrics workflow (EX / IPC / vf_real / dual-issue / stalls). Use when working in the pto-vmi repo, running pto-vmi kernels, or asked for a CCE/DSL regression run or triage.

skills.name: review-inconsistencies
skills.description: Compare a regression run against the pinned baseline (or another run): detect pass->fail regressions, fail->pass fixes, new/removed cases, and perf regressions using avg and p99 (flag p99 +15% even if avg is stable). Use when asked to review a run or compare it to the baseline.

skills.name: run-testcase
skills.description: Run one or more pto-isa benchmark/regression suites (CPU simulator ST and NPU simulator ST) and capture a reproducible run record. Use when asked to run a regression, run the suite matrix, execute a single suite/testcase, or re-run a suite for a target such as pto-isa.

skills.name: skill-maintainer
skills.description: Review regression results and user corrections, then propose or apply minimal, reviewable updates to the skills: capture lessons as LRN entries and promote them (gated + LLM-reviewed) into the shared corpus. Use when asked to update the skills, remember a correction, or review learnings/recent.md and promote reusable patterns.

skills.name: tool-perf-analysis
skills.description: Parse an NPU Profiling .npu-rep report (envelope payload: version/scope/report_id/report_path/op_name) into metrics (pipeline occupancy, compute utilization, resource conflicts, bandwidth, L2 hit rate, roofline), then output a data summary, bottleneck verdict, and optimization directions tagged with evidence/cost/exclusion/verification. Collection -> tool-perf-collect; implementation -> tool-perf-optimize; visualization -> tool-perf-report. Triggers: 'interpret this profiling report', 'what does this report tell us', 'how should I optimize this operator', report_path+scope payload.

skills.name: tool-perf-collect
skills.description: On-device NPU performance collection and speedup comparison vs a reference (msprof compare/quick modes; outputs performance.json + a markdown comparison). Collection + comparison only; analysis -> tool-perf-analysis; optimization strategy -> tool-perf-optimize; visualization -> tool-perf-report. Triggers: on-device performance, operator perf test, hardware perf verification, NPU profiling collection, speedup comparison.

skills.name: tool-perf-optimize
skills.description: Ascend C operator performance optimization strategy: Tiling modeling + multi-level flow analysis (device/cluster/core) using simulation diagrams + profiling data; a 4-step pipeline that fixes Tiling parameters. Directions come from tool-perf-analysis; reference implementations from tool-perf-practice. Triggers: operator perf tuning, flow analysis, Tiling correction, bound diagnosis, MC2 fused-op optimization, cluster-flow balancing.

skills.name: tool-perf-practice
skills.description: Ascend C operator optimization best-practice library, organized by operator family (matmul / mc2 / conversion / ...). Query for reference implementations and optimization experience during the implementation phase.

skills.name: tool-perf-report
skills.description: msOpProf -> self-contained interactive HTML performance report (Details, Roofline, Timeline, Cache, Source, on-chip memory, Warp Stall, instruction timeline, raw data). Collection -> tool-perf-collect; interpretation -> tool-perf-analysis. Triggers: generate a visualization report from collected data, view a perf module, rebuild a report from an existing collection dir.
